description: This source file implements the core logic for performing a binary search (bisection) to identify problematic commits in a Git repository. It includes functions for managing commit lists, performing the bisection algorithm, reading and setting bisect states, and handling user interactions during the bisect process.

methods.name: int count_distance(struct commit_list * entry)
methods.description: Calculates the distance from the current commit to the root of the commit graph by recursively counting the number of non-merge, interesting commits.

methods.name: void clear_distance(struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Resets the 'COUNTED' flag on commits in a list to prepare for a new distance calculation.

methods.name: int weight(struct commit_list * elem)
methods.description: Retrieves the weight (distance measure) for a commit in the bisect algorithm.

methods.name: void weight_set(struct commit_list * elem,int weight)
methods.description: Sets the weight for a commit in the bisect algorithm.

methods.name: int count_interesting_parents(struct commit * commit,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits of a given commit, considering bisect flags.

methods.name: int approx_halfway(struct commit_list * p,int nr)
methods.description: Determines whether a commit is approximately halfway in the commit graph relative to total commits, with some heuristics to handle small and large commit sets.

methods.name: void show_list(const char * debug,int counted,int nr,struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Displays information about a list of commits for debugging purposes if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects the commit from a list that is closest to the halfway point of the total commits, based on the weight.

methods.name: int compare_commit_dist(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting commits based on their distance to the midpoint in descending order.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection_sorted(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of commits based on their proximity to the halfway point, including additional decorations for visualization.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * do_find_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr,int * weights,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Performs the core bisection logic, computing commit weights, and selecting the commit that best divides the set into halves.

methods.name: void find_bisection(struct commit_list ** commit_list,int * reaches,int * all,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Main function to identify the commit that bisects the list of commits, updating the commit list and reach counts.

methods.name: int register_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles Git ref callbacks to identify good, bad, and skipped revisions.

methods.name: int read_bisect_refs(void)
methods.description: Reads the bisect-related references from the repository.

methods.name: git_path_bisect_names
methods.description: Constructs path string for the BISECT_NAMES file.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Reads bisect-related pathnames from a file into a string vector.

methods.name: char * join_oid_array_hex(struct oid_array * array,char delim)
methods.description: Joins an array of OIDs into a single hex string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * filter_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried,int show_all,int * count,int * skipped_first)
methods.description: Filters a list of commits to exclude those that are marked as skipped. Handles special logic for the first skipped commit.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * skip_away(struct commit_list * list,int count)
methods.description: Randomly skips some commits in a list, used for heuristic purposes in bisect.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * managed_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried)
methods.description: Filters a list of commits and skips some in a heuristic manner.

methods.name: void bisect_rev_setup(struct repository * r,struct rev_info * revs,struct strvec * rev_argv,const char * prefix,const char * bad_format,const char * good_format,int read_paths)
methods.description: Prepares revision options for a bisect run, including setting up the range of commits.

methods.name: void bisect_common(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Sets up common bisect options for revision walking.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error error_if_skipped_commits(struct commit_list * tried,const struct object_id * bad)
methods.description: Checks if only skipped commits are left to test, and signals an error if so.

methods.name: int is_expected_rev(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks whether a given revision matches an expected revision stored in a special ref.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_checkout(const struct object_id * bisect_rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks out a specific commit during bisect, updating refs accordingly.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object by its OID, dies if invalid.

methods.name: struct:commit ** get_bad_and_good_commits(struct repository * r,size_t * rev_nr)
methods.description: Collects the bad commit and all good commits into an array for processing.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error handle_bad_merge_base(void)
methods.description: Handles cases where the merge base is identified as bad or new, printing appropriate messages.

methods.name: void handle_skipped_merge_base(const struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Handles merge bases that need to be skipped, emitting warnings.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_merge_bases(size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Verifies merge bases between revisions, ensuring they are not 'bad' or 'skipped', and possibly prompting user testing.

methods.name: int check_ancestors(struct repository * r,size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Checks if all revisions are ancestors of a particular commit.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad(struct repository * r,const char * prefix,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Verifies that all 'good' commits are ancestors of the 'bad' commit, including handling merge bases.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Displays a commit's details using 'git show' for user inspection.

methods.name: void read_bisect_terms(char ** read_bad,char ** read_good)
methods.description: Reads user-defined terms for 'bad' and 'good' from configuration files.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next_all(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs a bisect step, selecting the next commit to test based on the current bisect state, and handling special conditions for success.

methods.name: int exp2i(int n)
methods.description: Computes 2 to the power of n.

methods.name: int estimate_bisect_steps(int all)
methods.description: Estimates the number of bisect steps remaining based on the total number of revisions.

methods.name: int mark_for_removal(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Marks bisect refs for removal during cleanup.

methods.name: int bisect_clean_state(void)
methods.description: Removes all bisect-related references and temporary files to reset the bisect state.

methods.name: unsigned get_prn(unsigned count)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int sqrti(int val)
methods.description: unavailable
